name: PunisherWatchlist
description: Adds eye buttons to movies, series, and episodes plus a personal Watchlist tab on the Jellyfin home screen.

versions.changelog: Turns Watchlist into an instant standalone history page without navigating through Home, preventing Home content flashes. Adds native-style played, favorite, play, Watchlist, and details controls plus unwatched episode badges to Watchlist cards, and excludes Jellyfin library-folder cards from the Watchlist eye action.

Adds Watchlist eyes to library cards without waiting for metadata lookups, uses Jellyfin's user-scoped item lookup for stored entries, replaces toggle calls with explicit add and remove operations, adds an immediate per-user browser cache, and loads the Watchlist client before Jellyfin's application scripts to prevent the home screen from flashing.

Fixes authenticated per-user Watchlist storage on Jellyfin 12.1, opens the Watchlist through the correct modern home route without a black page, renders the loading state immediately, restores titles, adds eye controls to all supported library cards, and centers the transparent native-style eye action.

Places Watchlist directly after Favorites in the desktop primary navigation and adds it directly below Favorites in the mobile drawer. Fixes the empty Watchlist page, preserves PunisherFinTheme backgrounds, renders added movies, series, and episodes, and makes the card eye control transparent like Jellyfin's native overlay actions.

Adds the Watchlist entry to Jellyfin 12's modern top navigation and mobile navigation. Moves card eye controls beside Jellyfin's favorite heart and only reveals them on card hover or keyboard focus on desktop while keeping them accessible on touch devices.
Initial release with per-user server-side Watchlists, eye buttons on cards and detail pages, a dedicated home-screen Watchlist tab, and PunisherFinTheme integration.
